def get_created_month(path):
    r=apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=token,file_path=path)
    created=r.get('created_at')
    m=int(created[5:7]) if created else None
    return m,created

info=[]
for p in files:
    m,created=get_created_month(p)
    info.append((p,created,m))

# categorize
cat={'Petra':[], 'Budapest':[], 'Amsterdam':[]}
for p,created,m in info:
    if created and created.startswith(str(year)+'-'):
        if m==2:
            cat['Petra'].append(p)
        elif m==3:
            cat['Budapest'].append(p)
        else:
            cat['Amsterdam'].append(p)
    else:
        # outside this year defaults to Amsterdam
        cat['Amsterdam'].append(p)

for k,v in cat.items():
    print(k,len(v))

# print few samples
for k,v in cat.items():
    print(k,'sample',v[0] if v else None)

from datetime import datetime

token = token  # reuse existing
base_dir='~/photographs/vacations/'

def dir_path(name):
    return f"{base_dir}{name}"

spots=['Petra','Budapest','Amsterdam']
# create dirs if missing
created=[]
for s in spots:
    exists = apis.file_system.directory_exists(access_token=token, directory_path=dir_path(s))
    print('exists',s,exists)
    if not exists.get('exists', False):
        # create recursively? not needed but safe. also allow_if_exists default true.
        resp = apis.file_system.create_directory(access_token=token, directory_path=dir_path(s))
        print('create',s,resp)
        created.append(s)
print('created_now',created)

# move files
results=[]
for s,paths in cat.items():
    for src in paths:
        fname=src.split('/')[-1]
        dst=f"/home/paul/photographs/vacations/{s}/{fname}"
        r=apis.file_system.move_file(access_token=token, source_file_path=src, destination_file_path=dst)
        results.append((s,fname,r.get('message'),dst))
print('moved_count',len(results))
print('sample_moves',results[:3])
# check any failures (move_file may raise exception if failure). if no exceptions, ok.

base_dir='~/photographs/vacations/'
access_token=token

# success criteria: base_dir has 0 files; subdirs have correct counts (Petra/Budapest/Amsterdam)
subdirs=['Petra','Budapest','Amsterdam']

# show base files (non-recursive)
base_files = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path=base_dir, entry_type='files', recursive=False)
print('base_files_count',len(base_files))
print('base_files',base_files[:5])

counts={}
files_by_subdir={}
for s in subdirs:
    d=f"{base_dir}{s}"
    lst=apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path=d, entry_type='files', recursive=False)
    counts[s]=len(lst)
    files_by_subdir[s]=lst
    print('subdir',s,'count',len(lst))
    print('sample',lst[:2])

print('counts_total',sum(counts.values()))
print('expected_counts', {k:len(v) for k,v in cat.items()})
